The '''Crystal Hollows Sack''' is a [[Sacks|Sack]] that holds materials from the {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}, except [[Gemstone]]s (see [[Gemstone Sack]]) and [[Hard Stone]] (see [[Mining Sack]]). This sack can be bought from [[Elizabeth]] in the [[Community Center]] for {{Bits|14k}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Shop Purchase ===
The '''Crystal Hollows Sack''' can be bought from [[Elizabeth]] in the [[Community Center]] for {{Bits|14k}}.

== Usage ==
The '''Crystal Hollows Sack''' can store items obtained in the {{Zone|Crystal Hollows}}.
